tiebreakers.description: Furthest ahead on the Turn Order Track

notes: family: area-majority (hybrid worker placement/engine). Treasures of the Lake awards per region are printed on the board, so entered as one number. In-round building bonus (2 VP per Building, max 12) is already on the VP track. Solo mode has its own target score (not modelled).
